paired_AP_uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional on shared training and single realized outer holdout, frozen inner selections and exploratory seeds. Not independent-fold confidence intervals, population superiority evidence, or automatic retention.

timings.accounting: Generator training shared once per seed/role; matching and initial-native/schedule shared once per classifier/role; selected alias incurs no extra fit; historical times never compared. Arm sampling/filtering/diagnostic/native times remain separate in metrics table.

limitations: Shared training and one fixed outer holdout; five exploratory seeds are NOT independent folds or superiority evidence.
Intervals conditional on realized shared training/holdout and already frozen inner choices; row bootstrap shared across all arms/seeds, joint bootstrap additionally resamples matched seeds.
Mask selection inner AP only; no outer-test configuration/tau/mask selection or automatic iteration/retention.
Historical original UGO/pure U2/latest lineage and genuine pure U2+F1 older lineage plus historical OOF U5_F1 are distinct end-to-end context, NOT fixed-round control A.

Common ties-even count rounding in ALL arms is user-approved; A is not exact historical continuous-count coordinates. Raw invalids are rejected without clipping/rescue, exact and near duplicates remain diagnostics.
After inner choices are frozen, former inner validation becomes active real outer training for the final generator; outer test never fits/anchors/generates.
